archive_purpose: Raw Claude Code trace for a FLAMINGO L1_m9 rotation-group tSZ power-spectrum task.

task.title: Create L1_m9 rotation group power spectrum analysis

recommended_dataset_layout.raw_layer: Store exact original JSONL traces byte-for-byte.
recommended_dataset_layout.normalized_layer: Optionally add Parquet tables with stable columns such as task_id, idx, type, timestamp, role, text, record_json, model, session_id, source_file, and sha256.
recommended_dataset_layout.task_grouping: Use one subfolder or config per FLAMINGO task so future traces can live in the same Hugging Face dataset.

publication_notes: The primary JSONL is intentionally raw and may include local paths, tool outputs, and Claude Code metadata.
Before public upload, scan for secrets or private credentials.
Keep checksums stable so downstream users can verify provenance.
